target.title: fix(agents): preserve yielded subagent continuations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

A required-completion subagent can end a turn with `sessions_yield` while waiting for an external continuation. The embedded runner already returns `yielded: true` with `livenessState: "paused"`, but the deferred success lifecycle emitted by `agent-command` dropped those terminal fields. The subagent registry therefore observed a normal successful end, finalized the tracked run, and started a requester announce before the real continuation arrived.

Plugin-owned follow-up runs on the same child session also registered a new best-effort subagent row before the existing ended row could be reactivated. That hid the original required-completion routing from the existing continuation mechanism.

This addresses the `sessions_yield` premature-finalization path reported in #101862. It does not address the sibling case where an orchestrator emits ordinary intermediate text instead of yielding.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Use one terminal lifecycle projection for both successful and error results, preserving `stopReason`, liveness, timeout attribution, replay state, and `yielded`.
- Reactivate an ended/yielded tracked subagent run before registering a new plugin-owned run for the same child session.
- Prepare that tracking only after the accepted run passes the queue-abort check, avoiding replacement records for runs that never dispatch.
- Reuse the existing `replaceSubagentRunAfterSteer` continuation path instead of adding a new plugin SDK or protocol surface.

## User Impact

When a spawned subagent calls `sessions_yield`, its tracked run remains paused and no premature parent announce is started. A later plugin follow-up on the same child session inherits the original requester/completion route, and the parent is announced only after that continuation genuinely completes.

No configuration, migration, or public SDK change is required.

## Evidence

Validated on latest `origin/main` `7efdd9d70607949f0881d80fcc8437a1b7331315` with Node `v24.15.0` and pnpm `11.2.2`:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts \
  src/agents/subagent-registry.test.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts \
  --maxWorkers=1

gateway: 476 passed
agents: 207 passed
total: 683 passed
```

Also passed:

```text
corepack pnpm exec oxfmt \
  src/agents/agent-command.ts \
  src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  src/agents/agent-command.ts \
  src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts

git diff --check
```

Structured autoreview was attempted repeatedly but produced no review result due to external reviewer failures: Codex was terminated twice with exit `-9`, Claude returned upstream `503` twice, and the Pi executable is not installed. Manual owner-boundary review and the focused lifecycle/registry/gateway suites above found no remaining issue.

AI-assisted: investigated, implemented, tested, and drafted with Codex under user direction.
